# Book of Giants Fragment 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 4Q530 col. vi (Cave 4) | **Condition:** moderately well preserved; epistolary format

---

**6:1** [...] Copy-of the-second tablet-of the-letter [...]

**6:2** [...] by-the-hand-of Enoch the-scribe-of interpretation [...]

**6:3** [...] to-all who-dwell-on the-earth [...]

**6:4** [...] and-to-the-Watchers [...] let-it-be-known to-you [...]

**6:5** [...] that your-petition shall-not-be-granted to-you [...]

**6:6** [...] To-the-Watchers and-the-giants: Let-it-be-known to-you that your-deeds [...]

**6:7** [...] and-your-deeds and-those-of your-wives [...]

**6:8** [...] have-cried-out against-you [...]

**6:9** [...] your-requests will-not-be-granted to-you [...]

**6:10** [...] from-this-day to-eternity [...]

**6:11** [...] and-your-wives [...] and-your-children [...] through-your-fornication on-the-earth [...]

**6:12** [...] there-has-been upon-you [...] destruction and-bondage [...]

**6:13** [...] the-land will-not-be left to-you [...]

**6:14** [...] for you-have-loved the-corruption [...]

**6:15** [...] and-the-violence and-the-blood-of the-righteous [...]

**6:16** [...] there-will-be upon-you [...] the-sentence-of judgment [...]

**6:17** [...] and-the-judgment-of the-great-flood [...]

**6:18** [...] will-come upon-you and-upon your-seed [...]

**6:19** [...] and-you-shall-be-bound in-the-depths-of the-earth [...]

**6:20** [...] until the-judgment-of eternity [...]

---

*EMET notes: Fragment 6 (Enoch's Response to the Giants). Source: 4Q530 col. vi. Aramaic text from Cave 4 Qumran. Hyphenated compounds preserve Aramaic construct-chain syntax and bound morphemes. Square brackets indicate genuine manuscript lacunae where the leather has deteriorated or broken away. The Book of Giants is an Aramaic expansion of the Watcher myth from 1 Enoch 6-16, featuring the Nephilim giants Ohya, Hahya (sons of Shemihazah), Mahaway (son of Baraq'el), and the hero Gilgamesh.*
